sinopsis.es: Los críticos de arte Roberta Smith y Jerry Saltz, estrellas en su campo y profundamente enamorados, abren las puertas a su sorprendentemente humilde mundo, reflexionando sobre cuatro décadas de arte neoyorquino.
sinopsis.en: Art critics Roberta Smith and Jerry Saltz — rockstars in their field and deeply in love — invite cameras into their surprisingly humble life, reflecting on four decades of New York art and each other.
